title: The Book of 2 Chronicles Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Chronicles — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.decoded: Solomon, the son of David, was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him and greatly honored him.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and hundreds, to the judges, and to every governor throughout Israel, the leaders of the families.

verses.kjv: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: So Solomon, along with all the people with him, went to the high place at Gibeon because there was the tent of meeting of God, which Moses, the servant of the LORD, had made in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: But David had brought the ark of God up from Kirjath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had set up a tent for it in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.decoded: Also, he placed the bronze altar that Bezaleel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made in front of the LORD's tabernacle. Solomon and the assembly went to it to seek guidance.

verses.kjv: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.decoded: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar in front of the LORD, which was at the meeting tent, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

verses.kjv: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.decoded: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, Ask what I should give you.

verses.kjv: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.decoded: And Solomon said to God, You have shown great mercy to David my father, and have made me to reign in his place.

verses.kjv: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.decoded: Now, O LORD God, let your promise to David my father be confirmed, because you have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.

verses.kjv: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.decoded: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, so I can lead this people when I go out and come in, because who else can judge your great people?

verses.kjv: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.decoded: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked for riches, wealth, or honor, nor the life of your enemies, nor have you asked for long life; but you have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, so that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king:

verses.kjv: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.decoded: Wisdom and knowledge are given to you; and I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as no kings before you have had, and none after you will have the same.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon returned from his trip to the high place at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from in front of the meeting tent, and ruled over Israel.

verses.kjv: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Solomon collected chariots and horsemen: he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, which he stationed in the cities with chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.decoded: The king made silver and gold in Jerusalem as abundant as stones, and he made cedar trees as plentiful as the sycamore trees that are in the valley.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.decoded: And Solomon had horses brought from Egypt, along with linen yarn; the king’s merchants bought the linen yarn at a cost.

verses.kjv: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.decoded: They brought up and took out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred and fifty shekels; and in this way, they brought out horses for all the kings of the Hittites and for the kings of Syria.

verses.kjv: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.decoded: Solomon decided to build a temple to honor the LORD, and a palace for his kingdom.

verses.kjv: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.decoded: And Solomon counted seventy thousand men to carry loads, eighty thousand to cut stone in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred to supervise them.

verses.kjv: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.decoded: Solomon sent a message to Huram, the king of Tyre, saying, Just as you helped my father David by sending him cedar trees to build a house to live in, do the same for me.

verses.kjv: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
verses.decoded: Look, I am building a house in the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn sweet incense before him, and to provide the continual showbread, and to offer burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the special feasts of the LORD our God. This is a law forever for Israel.

verses.kjv: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
verses.decoded: The house that I am building is great because our God is greater than all other gods.

verses.kjv: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.decoded: But who can build a house for him, since the sky and the highest heavens cannot hold him? Who am I, then, that I should build a house for him, except to offer burnt sacrifices before him?

verses.kjv: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.decoded: So now send me a man skilled in working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, purple, crimson, and blue, and who is able to do engraving, along with the skilled men who are with me in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David appointed.

verses.kjv: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.decoded: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees from Lebanon, because I know that your servants are skilled at cutting timber in Lebanon; and look, my servants will be with your servants.

verses.kjv: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.decoded: Also, prepare a large amount of timber for me, because the house I am about to build will be extremely large and magnificent.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.decoded: Look, I will give to your servants, the workers who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of crushed wheat, twenty thousand measures of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

verses.kjv: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.decoded: Then Huram, the king of Tyre, replied in a letter that he sent to Solomon, saying, Because the LORD has loved his people, he has made you king over them.

verses.kjv: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.decoded: Huram also said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, filled with wisdom and understanding, who can build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

verses.kjv: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
verses.decoded: And now I have sent a skilled man, filled with understanding, from Huram my father,

verses.kjv: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
verses.decoded: The son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man from Tyre, skilled in working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, in purple, blue, fine linen, and crimson; also skilled in engraving any kind of engraving, and in discovering every design that will be given to him, along with your skilled men and the skilled men of my lord David your father.

verses.kjv: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.decoded: So now, let my lord send the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine that he mentioned to his servants.

verses.kjv: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: And we will cut wood from Lebanon, as much as you need; and we will bring it to you on rafts by sea to Joppa; and you will carry it up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: Solomon counted all the foreigners living in the land of Israel, according to the census that his father David had taken; and they were found to be one hundred fifty thousand, three thousand, and six hundred.

verses.kjv: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.decoded: He assigned seventy thousand of them to carry loads, eighty thousand to cut stone in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred supervisors to direct the workers.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon started to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.decoded: He started building on the second day of the second month, during the fourth year of his reign.

verses.kjv: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.decoded: These are the instructions Solomon received for building the house of God. The length measured in cubits according to the first measurement was sixty cubits, and the width was twenty cubits.

verses.kjv: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.decoded: The porch at the front of the house was as long as the width of the house, twenty cubits, and its height was one hundred and twenty cubits. He covered the inside of it with pure gold.

verses.kjv: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.decoded: And he covered the main room with fir wood, which he covered with pure gold, and placed palm trees and chains on it.

verses.kjv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.decoded: He decorated the house with precious stones to make it beautiful, and the gold was gold from Parvaim.

verses.kjv: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.decoded: He covered the house, the beams, the posts, the walls, and the doors with gold; and he carved cherubim on the walls.

verses.kjv: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.decoded: He made the most holy place, its length was the same as its width, twenty cubits by twenty cubits, and he covered it with pure gold, weighing six hundred talents.

verses.kjv: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.decoded: The nails weighed fifty shekels of gold. He covered the upper rooms with gold.

verses.kjv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.decoded: And in the most holy place, he made two cherubim as carved images, and covered them with gold.

verses.kjv: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.decoded: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: one wing of one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was also five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.kjv: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.decoded: One wing of the other cherub was five cubits long, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was also five cubits long, connecting to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.kjv: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.decoded: The wings of these cherubim stretched out twenty cubits; they stood on their feet, and their faces were turned inward.

verses.kjv: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.decoded: He made the curtain from blue, purple, and crimson cloth, and fine linen, and embroidered cherubim on it.

verses.kjv: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.decoded: He also made two pillars in front of the temple, each thirty-five cubits high, and the decorative tops on each of them were five cubits high.

verses.kjv: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.decoded: He made chains, like those in the sanctuary, and placed them on the tops of the pillars; then he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.

verses.kjv: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.decoded: He set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right side and the other on the left side; he named the one on the right Jachin, and the one on the left Boaz.

verses.kjv: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.decoded: Also, he made a bronze altar that was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

verses.kjv: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.decoded: He also made a large basin of molten metal, measuring ten cubits from one edge to the other, circular in shape, and five cubits high; a measuring line of thirty cubits went all the way around it.

verses.kjv: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.decoded: And under it was the image of oxen, which surrounded it all around: ten in a cubit, surrounding the basin all around. Two rows of oxen were cast when it was made.

verses.kjv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.decoded: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the sea was placed above them, with all their back parts turned inward.

verses.kjv: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.decoded: And its thickness was the width of a hand, and the rim of it was like the rim of a cup, decorated with lily flowers; and it held and contained three thousand baths.

verses.kjv: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.decoded: He also made ten basins and placed five on the right side and five on the left side for washing in them. They washed the things they offered as burnt offerings in these basins, but the large basin was for the priests to wash in.

verses.kjv: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.decoded: He made ten gold candlesticks according to their design and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.

verses.kjv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.decoded: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made one hundred gold basins.

verses.kjv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.decoded: Also, he made the courtyard for the priests, and the large courtyard, and doors for the courtyard, and covered the doors with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.decoded: He placed the large basin on the right side at the east end, facing the south.

verses.kjv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.decoded: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. Huram completed the work he was assigned to do for King Solomon for the house of God.

verses.kjv: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.decoded: That is, the two pillars, and the decorative knobs, and the capitals that were on top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two knobs of the capitals which were on top of the pillars;

verses.kjv: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.decoded: There were four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; each wreath had two rows of pomegranates to cover the two knobs of the capitals that were on the pillars.

verses.kjv: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.decoded: He also made stands, and he made basins on the stands;

verses.kjv: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.decoded: One large basin, and twelve oxen standing under it.

verses.kjv: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.
verses.decoded: Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the fleshhooks, and all their tools for King Solomon for the house of the LORD out of polished bronze.

verses.kjv: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.decoded: The king threw them into the Jordan plain, in the clay soil between Succoth and Zeredathah.

verses.kjv: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.decoded: So Solomon made all these vessels in very large quantities because the weight of the bronze could not be measured.

verses.kjv: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.decoded: And Solomon made all the vessels for the house of God, including the golden altar and the tables on which the showbread was placed;

verses.kjv: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.decoded: Also, the candlesticks with their lamps, so that they would burn in the prescribed way in front of the sanctuary, made of pure gold;

verses.kjv: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.decoded: He made the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs out of gold, and that pure gold;

verses.kjv: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.decoded: The snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the censers were made of pure gold. The entrance of the house, the inner doors for the most holy place, and the doors of the temple were made of gold.

verses.kjv: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
verses.decoded: So all the work that Solomon did for the house of the LORD was completed. Solomon brought in all the things that his father David had dedicated, including the silver, the gold, and all the instruments, and he placed them among the treasures of the house of God.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon gathered the elders of Israel, and all the leaders of the tribes, the heads of the families of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.kjv: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
verses.decoded: Therefore, all the men of Israel gathered together to the king during the festival in the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.decoded: All the leaders of Israel came, and the Levites carried the ark.

verses.kjv: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.decoded: They carried up the ark, the meeting tent, and all the holy items that were in the tent; the priests and the Levites carried all these up.

verses.kjv: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.decoded: Also King Solomon and all the assembly of Israel who were gathered to him in front of the ark sacrificed sheep and oxen that were too many to count or number.

verses.kjv: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.decoded: The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, to the inner sanctuary of the temple, into the most holy place, right under the wings of the cherubim.

verses.kjv: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.decoded: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its carrying poles above.

verses.kjv: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.decoded: They pulled out the poles of the ark so that the ends of the poles could be seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary; but they could not be seen from outside. And it remains there to this day.

verses.kjv: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.decoded: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses placed there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
verses.decoded: It happened when the priests came out of the holy place (because all the priests who were there were made holy and were not waiting in their assigned groups at that time):

verses.kjv: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.decoded: Also the Levites who were the singers, all of them from Asaph, from Heman, and from Jeduthun, along with their sons and their brothers, dressed in white linen, holding cymbals, psalteries, and harps, stood at the east side of the altar, and with them were one hundred and twenty priests blowing trumpets.

verses.kjv: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the Lord;
verses.decoded: It happened exactly as the trumpeters and singers were united, making one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they raised their voices with the trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments, and praised the LORD, saying, 'For he is good; his mercy lasts forever,' then the house was filled with a cloud, the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.
verses.decoded: The priests could not continue serving because of the cloud, because the glory of the LORD had filled the temple.

verses.kjv: Then said Solomon, The Lord hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon said, The LORD has said that he will live in the thick darkness.

verses.kjv: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.decoded: But I have built a house for you to live in, and a place for you to dwell forever.

verses.kjv: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.decoded: Then the king turned his face and blessed the entire assembly of Israel, and all the assembly of Israel stood up.

verses.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.decoded: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who has with his hands accomplished what he promised with his mouth to my father David, saying,

verses.kjv: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
verses.decoded: From the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I did not choose any city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for my name to be there; nor did I choose any man to be a ruler over my people Israel.

verses.kjv: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
verses.decoded: But I have chosen Jerusalem so that my name will be there; and I have chosen David to be the leader over my people Israel.

verses.kjv: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: David my father deeply desired to build a temple for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: But the Lord said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.decoded: But the LORD said to David my father, Since it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well because it was in your heart.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.decoded: However, you will not build the house; but your son who will come from your own body, he will build the house for my name.

verses.kjv: The Lord therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: The LORD has therefore fulfilled the word that he spoke, because I have taken the place of David my father and have been placed on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised, and I have built the temple for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, that he made with the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And I have placed the ark inside it, which contains the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
verses.decoded: He stood in front of the LORD's altar, with all the people of Israel watching, and he stretched out his hands:

verses.kjv: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.decoded: Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and placed it in the middle of the courtyard. He stood on it, knelt down on his knees before the entire assembly of Israel, and stretched out his hands toward heaven.

verses.kjv: And said, O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.decoded: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth; you keep your promises and show mercy to your servants who walk before you with all their hearts:

verses.kjv: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: You who have kept the promise you made to your servant David my father; you spoke with your mouth and have fulfilled it with your hand, just as it is today.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.decoded: Now, LORD God of Israel, keep the promise you made to your servant David my father, saying, 'There will never fail to be a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel,' as long as your children pay attention to how they live and follow my law, just as you have walked before me.

verses.kjv: Now then, O Lord God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
verses.decoded: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let your word be confirmed, which you have spoken to your servant David.

verses.kjv: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.decoded: But will God really live with people on the earth? Look, even heaven and the highest heaven cannot hold you; how much less this house that I have built!

verses.kjv: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.decoded: Therefore, pay attention to the prayer of your servant and to his request, O LORD my God, and listen to the cry and the prayer that your servant prays before you:

verses.kjv: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.decoded: May your eyes be open on this house day and night, on the place where you said you would put your name; to listen to the prayer that your servant prays toward this place.

verses.kjv: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.decoded: Listen therefore to the prayers of your servant and of your people Israel, which they will offer toward this place: listen from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

verses.kjv: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.decoded: If a person sins against their neighbor, and an oath is imposed on them to make them swear, and the oath comes before your altar in this house;

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.decoded: Then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants by punishing the wicked, by paying back their actions on their own heads; and by declaring the righteous innocent, by giving them what they deserve according to their righteousness.

verses.kjv: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.decoded: And if your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you; and they come back and admit your name, and pray and ask for help in your presence in this house;

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.decoded: Then hear from heaven, forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.

verses.kjv: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.decoded: When the sky is closed and there is no rain because they have sinned against you; but if they pray toward this place, confess your name, and turn away from their sin when you discipline them;

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.decoded: Then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants and of your people Israel, when you have taught them the right way to live; and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people as their inheritance.

verses.kjv: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.decoded: If there is famine in the land, if there is disease, if there is blight or mildew, locusts, or caterpillars; if their enemies surround them in the cities of their land; whatever disease or sickness there is:

verses.kjv: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.decoded: Then whatever prayer or request any person or all your people Israel make, when each one knows their own trouble and their own pain, and spreads out their hands in this house:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.decoded: Then hear from heaven your dwelling place, forgive, and give to each person according to all their actions, because you know their heart; (for you alone know the hearts of all people:)

verses.kjv: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.decoded: So that they may respect you and follow your ways as long as they live in the land you gave to our ancestors.

verses.kjv: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name’s sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.decoded: Also, concerning the foreigner who is not part of your people Israel, but has come from a distant country because of your great name, your powerful hand, and your outstretched arm; if they come and pray in this house;

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.decoded: Then hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and do everything the foreigner asks of you, so that all the people of the earth may know your name, fear you as your people Israel do, and understand that this house I have built is called by your name.

verses.kjv: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.decoded: If your people go out to war against their enemies by the way you send them, and they pray to you facing this city that you have chosen, and the house that I have built for your name;

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.decoded: Then hear their prayer and their request from heaven, and defend their case.

verses.kjv: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.decoded: If they sin against you, (because there is no one who does not sin,) and you become angry with them, and hand them over to their enemies, and they are taken captive to a land far away or nearby;

verses.kjv: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.decoded: But if they remember themselves in the land where they are taken captive, and turn and pray to you in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done wrong, and have acted wickedly;

verses.kjv: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.decoded: If they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land, which you gave to their ancestors, and toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
verses.decoded: Then hear from the heavens, from your dwelling place, their prayer and their requests, defend their case, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

verses.kjv: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.decoded: Now, my God, I ask you, let your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.kjv: Now therefore arise, O Lord God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.decoded: Now, therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter your resting place, you and the ark of your strength; let your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your faithful people rejoice in your goodness.

verses.kjv: O Lord God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
verses.decoded: O LORD God, do not turn away your face from your anointed one; remember the kindness you showed to David your servant.

verses.kjv: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.decoded: After Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and burned up the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

verses.kjv: And the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord, because the glory of the Lord had filled the Lord’s house.
verses.decoded: The priests were unable to enter the house of the LORD because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's house.

verses.kjv: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: When all the people of Israel saw the fire come down and the glory of the LORD on the temple, they bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and praised the LORD, saying, "He is good, because his mercy lasts forever."

verses.kjv: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then the king and all the people made sacrifices in front of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred and twenty thousand sheep; so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

verses.kjv: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the Lord, which David the king had made to praise the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
verses.decoded: The priests performed their duties; the Levites also played musical instruments for the LORD, which King David had made to praise the LORD because his mercy lasts forever, as David praised through their service; and the priests blew trumpets in front of them, and all Israel stood.

verses.kjv: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
verses.decoded: Also, Solomon made the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD holy, because there he offered burnt offerings and the fat from the peace offerings, since the bronze altar that Solomon had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat.

verses.kjv: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
verses.decoded: At the same time, Solomon celebrated the feast for seven days, and all Israel was with him, a very large gathering, from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, they held a special gathering because they celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days.

verses.kjv: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the Lord had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
verses.decoded: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, happy and joyful in their hearts because of the kindness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

verses.kjv: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord, and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of the Lord, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
verses.decoded: So Solomon completed the house of the LORD and the king’s palace. Everything Solomon planned to build in the house of the LORD and in his own palace, he successfully accomplished.

verses.kjv: And the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
verses.decoded: The LORD appeared to Solomon at night and said to him, I have heard your prayer, and I have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.

verses.kjv: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
verses.decoded: If I close the sky so that no rain falls, or if I order the locusts to eat the land, or if I send disease among my people;

verses.kjv: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.decoded: If my people, who are called by my name, humble themselves, pray, seek my presence, and turn away from their evil ways; then I will listen from heaven, forgive their sins, and heal their land.

verses.kjv: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.decoded: Now my eyes will be open, and my ears will listen carefully to the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.kjv: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.decoded: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, so that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will always be there.

verses.kjv: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
verses.decoded: And as for you, if you will live in my presence, just as David your father lived, and do everything I have commanded you, and obey my laws and my rules;

verses.kjv: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.
verses.decoded: Then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, just as I promised your father David, saying, There will always be a man to rule in Israel.

verses.kjv: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.decoded: But if you turn away and abandon my laws and my commands, which I have given you, and go and serve other gods and worship them;

verses.kjv: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
verses.decoded: Then I will remove them completely from my land that I have given them; and I will reject this house, which I have made holy for my name, and I will make it a proverb and a warning among all nations.

verses.kjv: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
verses.decoded: And this house, which is tall, will be a wonder to everyone who passes by it; so that they will say, Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?

verses.kjv: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
verses.decoded: And the answer will be, Because they abandoned the LORD God of their ancestors, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took hold of other gods, worshiped them, and served them: therefore he has brought all this disaster upon them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the Lord, and his own house,
verses.decoded: After twenty years had passed, during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own house,

verses.kjv: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
verses.decoded: The cities that Huram had given back to Solomon, Solomon built up and made the people of Israel live in them.

verses.kjv: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.decoded: Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and defeated it.

verses.kjv: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.decoded: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities that he built in Hamath.

verses.kjv: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.decoded: He also built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

verses.kjv: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.decoded: And Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon owned, and all the cities for chariots, and the cities for horsemen, and everything that Solomon wanted to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land he ruled.

verses.kjv: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
verses.decoded: Regarding all the people who remained from the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not part of Israel,

verses.kjv: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.decoded: But the children of those people who remained in the land after them, whom the children of Israel did not destroy, Solomon made them pay tribute until this day.

verses.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.decoded: But Solomon did not make any of the children of Israel servants for his work; instead, they were soldiers, commanders of his army, and leaders of his chariots and horsemen.

verses.kjv: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.decoded: These were the main officers of King Solomon, two hundred and fifty in total, who governed the people.

verses.kjv: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the Lord hath come.
verses.decoded: And Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh from the city of David to the house he had built for her, because he said, My wife will not live in the house of David, king of Israel, since the places there are holy, where the ark of the LORD has come.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,
verses.decoded: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built in front of the entrance,

verses.kjv: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.decoded: Also, a fixed amount was offered every day according to Moses' command, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the special festivals, three times a year: during the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.

verses.kjv: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.decoded: He assigned the priests to their duties and the Levites to their responsibilities to praise and serve before the priests, following the daily requirements, just as David his father had arranged. The gatekeepers were also assigned their shifts at each gate, because David, the man of God, had commanded it that way.

verses.kjv: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.decoded: And they did not disobey the king's orders given to the priests and Levites about any matter or about the treasures.

verses.kjv: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.
verses.decoded: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared up to the day when the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, and until it was completed. So the house of the LORD was finished.

verses.kjv: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth, which are by the sea in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.decoded: Huram sent ships through his servants, along with servants who knew about the sea; they went with Solomon's servants to Ophir, brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and delivered it to King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.decoded: When the queen of Sheba heard about Solomon's reputation, she came to test Solomon with difficult questions in Jerusalem, bringing a very large group, camels carrying spices, a lot of gold, and precious stones. When she arrived at Solomon, she talked with him about everything on her mind.

verses.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.decoded: And Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing hidden from Solomon that he did not explain to her.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.decoded: When the queen of Sheba saw Solomon's wisdom and the house he had built,

verses.kjv: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.decoded: The food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his officials, and their clothing; his cupbearers and their clothing; and the way he went up into the house of the LORD—she had no more strength left.

verses.kjv: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
verses.decoded: And she said to the king, The report I heard in my own country about your deeds and your wisdom was true.

verses.kjv: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.decoded: However, I did not believe their words until I came and saw it with my own eyes; and, look, only half of the greatness of your wisdom was told to me, because you exceed the reputation I heard.

verses.kjv: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.decoded: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.decoded: Blessed be the LORD your God, who was pleased with you to put you on his throne as king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel and wanted to establish them forever, he made you king over them to carry out judgment and justice.

verses.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
verses.decoded: And she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, a great abundance of spices, and precious stones; there was no spice like the spice that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.decoded: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

verses.kjv: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the Lord, and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.decoded: The king made terraces from the algum trees leading to the house of the LORD and to the king’s palace, and he made harps and psalteries for the singers; nothing like these had ever been seen before in the land of Judah.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she wanted, whatever she asked for, in addition to what she had already brought to the king. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants.

verses.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.decoded: The amount of gold that Solomon received in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold.

verses.kjv: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.decoded: In addition to what traders and merchants brought, all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon made two hundred shields of hammered gold; each shield weighed six hundred shekels of hammered gold.

verses.kjv: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: He made three hundred shields out of beaten gold; each shield weighed three hundred shekels of gold. The king placed them in the house of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.decoded: Also, the king made a large throne out of ivory and covered it with pure gold.

verses.kjv: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
verses.decoded: There were six steps leading up to the throne, with a gold footstool attached to the throne, supports on each side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the supports.

verses.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.decoded: Twelve lions stood on one side and twelve on the other, on the six steps. Nothing like this was made in any kingdom.

verses.kjv: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.decoded: All the drinking cups of King Solomon were made of gold, and all the vessels in the house of the forest of Lebanon were made of pure gold; none were made of silver, because silver was not considered valuable during the days of Solomon.

verses.kjv: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.decoded: Because the king’s ships traveled to Tarshish with Huram’s servants, every three years the ships from Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

verses.kjv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
verses.decoded: All the kings of the earth came to Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had given him.

verses.kjv: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.decoded: And each man brought his gift: silver vessels, gold vessels, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules, as a regular yearly tribute.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; he stationed them in the cities with chariots and also with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.decoded: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, and up to the border of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.decoded: The king made silver in Jerusalem as common as stones, and he made cedar trees as plentiful as the sycamore trees that grow abundantly in the low plains.

verses.kjv: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.decoded: They brought horses to Solomon from Egypt and from all other countries.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.decoded: Now the rest of Solomon's deeds, from beginning to end, are they not recorded in the book of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

verses.kjv: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.decoded: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

verses.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Solomon died and was buried in the city of David his father, and his son Rehoboam became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
verses.decoded: Rehoboam went to Shechem because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.decoded: It happened that when Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt because he had fled from King Solomon, heard about it, Jeroboam came back from Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.decoded: They sent for him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.kjv: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
verses.decoded: Your father made our burden hard to bear; now then, make the hard service your father put on us lighter, and we will serve you.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Come back to me after three days. And the people left.

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.decoded: And King Rehoboam consulted with the older men who had served before Solomon his father while he was still alive, saying, What advice do you give me to respond to these people?

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.decoded: And they spoke to him, saying, If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever.

verses.kjv: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
verses.decoded: But he rejected the advice that the older men gave him, and instead took advice from the young men who grew up with him and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
verses.decoded: And he said to them, What advice do you give so that we can respond to these people who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten the burden that your father placed on us?

verses.kjv: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.decoded: And the young men who were raised with him said to him, "This is how you should answer the people who spoke to you, saying, 'Your father made our burden heavy, but you make it somewhat lighter for us.' You should say to them, 'My smallest finger will be thicker than my father's waist.'"

verses.kjv: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.decoded: Because my father placed a heavy yoke on you, I will add even more to your yoke; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.

verses.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.decoded: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king commanded, saying, Come back to me on the third day.

verses.kjv: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.decoded: The king answered them harshly, and King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the older men,

verses.kjv: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.decoded: He answered them following the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your burden heavy, but I will make it even heavier: my father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions.

verses.kjv: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.decoded: So the king did not listen to the people, because the matter was from God, to fulfill the word the LORD had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.kjv: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
verses.decoded: When all Israel saw that the king would not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, What share do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Everyone go back to your own tents, Israel. And now, David, take care of your own house. So all Israel went back to their tents.

verses.kjv: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.decoded: But the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah were ruled by Rehoboam.

verses.kjv: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was in charge of the tribute; and the people of Israel threw stones at him until he died. But King Rehoboam hurried to get into his chariot to escape to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.decoded: And Israel has been in rebellion against the family of David up to this day.

verses.kjv: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.decoded: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he gathered from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors to fight against Israel, so that he could bring the kingdom back to Rehoboam.

verses.kjv: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.decoded: But the message from the LORD came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.decoded: Speak to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the people of Israel living in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, You will not go up or fight against your brothers; each of you return to your own house, because this is my decision. And they obeyed the words of the LORD and stopped going to fight against Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.decoded: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built cities for defense in Judah.

verses.kjv: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.decoded: He also built Bethlehem, Etam, and Tekoa,

verses.kjv: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.decoded: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

verses.kjv: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.decoded: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

verses.kjv: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
