verses.decoded: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and rescued him from among the king’s sons who were killed, and placed him and his nurse in a bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (because she was Ahaziah’s sister), hid him from Athaliah so that she did not kill him.

verses.kjv: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.decoded: He was hidden with them in the house of God for six years, while Athaliah ruled over the land.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.decoded: In the seventh year, Jehoiada made himself strong and took the commanders of hundreds—Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri—and made a covenant with them.

verses.kjv: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: They traveled throughout Judah, gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah, along with the leaders of the families of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the Lord hath said of the sons of David.
verses.decoded: And all the people made an agreement with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, Look, the king’s son will rule, just as the LORD has said about the sons of David.

verses.kjv: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
verses.decoded: This is what you will do: One third of you, the priests and the Levites, will be gatekeepers on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And a third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: One third will be at the king’s house; one third will be at the gate of the foundation; and all the people will be in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: But let none come into the house of the Lord, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But no one should enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are holy, but all the people must keep watch for the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
verses.decoded: And the Levites will surround the king, each man holding his weapon in his hand; and anyone else who comes into the house will be put to death: but stay with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.

verses.kjv: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.decoded: So the Levites and all the people of Judah did everything that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and each man took his group of men who were supposed to come in on the Sabbath, along with those who were supposed to go out on the Sabbath, because Jehoiada the priest did not dismiss the groups.

verses.kjv: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David’s, which were in the house of God.
verses.decoded: Also, Jehoiada the priest gave the commanders of hundreds spears, small shields, and large shields that had belonged to King David, which were kept in the house of God.

verses.kjv: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.decoded: He positioned all the people, each man holding his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along the altar and the temple, surrounding the king.

verses.kjv: Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.
verses.decoded: Then they brought out the king's son, placed the crown on him, gave him the official document, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, 'God save the king.'

verses.kjv: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the Lord:
verses.decoded: When Athaliah heard the sound of the people running and praising the king, she went to the people in the house of the LORD:

verses.kjv: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.decoded: She looked and saw the king standing at his pillar at the entrance, with the princes and the trumpets beside the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets, along with the singers playing musical instruments and those who taught others to sing praises. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"

verses.kjv: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the commanders of hundreds who were in charge of the army and said to them, "Take her out of the ranks, and anyone who follows her must be killed with the sword." The priest said, "Do not kill her inside the house of the LORD."

verses.kjv: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.
verses.decoded: So they grabbed her; and when she reached the entrance of the horse gate near the king’s house, they killed her there.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the Lord’s people.
verses.decoded: And Jehoiada made an agreement between himself, all the people, and the king, that they would be the LORD’S people.

verses.kjv: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.decoded: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, tore it down, broke his altars and his images into pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.

verses.kjv: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the Lord by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the Lord, to offer the burnt offerings of the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.
verses.decoded: Also Jehoiada assigned the duties in the house of the LORD through the priests, the Levites, whom David had organized in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with joy and singing, as David had commanded.

verses.kjv: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the Lord, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.decoded: He placed the gatekeepers at the entrances of the house of the LORD so that no one who was unclean in any way could enter.

verses.kjv: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the Lord: and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.decoded: He took the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the leaders of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the LORD. They entered through the main gate into the king’s house and placed the king on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.kjv: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.decoded: All the people in the land were happy, and the city was peaceful after they had killed Athaliah with the sword.

verses.kjv: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
verses.decoded: Joash was seven years old when he started to rule, and he ruled for forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah from Beer-sheba.

verses.kjv: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.decoded: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD throughout the entire time that Jehoiada the priest was alive.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.decoded: Jehoiada married two wives, and he had sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: After this, Joash decided to repair the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
verses.decoded: He gathered the priests and the Levites and said to them, 'Go out to the cities of Judah and collect money from all Israel each year to repair the house of your God, and make sure you hurry the work.' But the Levites did not hurry it.

verses.kjv: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the Lord, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.decoded: The king called for Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, Why have you not asked the Levites to bring in the collection from Judah and Jerusalem, according to the command of Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the assembly of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

verses.kjv: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the Lord did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.decoded: Because the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had destroyed the house of God; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD to Baalim.

verses.kjv: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And by the king’s order, they made a chest and placed it outside at the gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the Lord the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: They announced throughout Judah and Jerusalem that people should bring to the LORD the offering that Moses, the servant of God, commanded Israel to give while they were in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.decoded: All the leaders and all the people were happy, and they brought money and put it into the chest until they had finished.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.decoded: It happened that whenever the chest was brought to the king’s office by the Levites, and they saw that there was a lot of money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came, emptied the chest, took the money, and carried it back to their place. They did this every day and collected a large amount of money.

verses.kjv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The king and Jehoiada gave the money to those who did the work of serving in the house of the LORD, and they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, as well as workers who shaped iron and brass to fix the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.decoded: So the workers worked, and the work was completed by them, and they restored the house of God to its proper condition, and made it stronger.

verses.kjv: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the Lord, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.decoded: When they had finished, they brought the remaining money to the king and Jehoiada. From this money, they made vessels for the house of the LORD, including vessels for service, for offerings, spoons, and vessels made of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continuously throughout all the days of Jehoiada.

verses.kjv: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
verses.decoded: But Jehoiada grew old and lived a long life when he died; he was one hundred and thirty years old when he died.

verses.kjv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
verses.decoded: They buried him in the city of David among the kings because he had done good in Israel, both to God and to his household.

verses.kjv: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.decoded: After Jehoiada died, the leaders of Judah came and showed respect to the king. Then the king listened to them.

verses.kjv: And they left the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
verses.decoded: They abandoned the house of the LORD God of their ancestors and worshiped groves and idols; as a result, anger came upon Judah and Jerusalem because of this sin.

verses.kjv: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the Lord; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.decoded: But he sent prophets to them to bring them back to the LORD; and they spoke against them, but they did not listen.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the Lord, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the Lord, he hath also forsaken you.
verses.decoded: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, who was standing above the people, and said to them, This is what God says, Why do you break the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot succeed? Because you have abandoned the LORD, he has also abandoned you.

verses.kjv: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They planned against him and threw stones at him on the king's orders in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The Lord look upon it, and require it.
verses.decoded: So King Joash did not remember the kindness that Jehoiada his father had done for him, but killed his son. And when he died, he said, 'May the LORD see this and hold him accountable.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.decoded: At the end of the year, the army of Syria came against him. They went to Judah and Jerusalem, destroyed all the leaders among the people, and sent all their loot to the king of Damascus.

verses.kjv: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the Lord delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.decoded: Because the Syrian army came with only a small group of soldiers, the LORD allowed a very large army to be handed over to them, since they had abandoned the LORD God of their ancestors. So they carried out judgment against Joash.

verses.kjv: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.decoded: And when they left him, because they left him in severe illness, his own servants plotted against him because of the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him while he was in bed, and he died. They buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.

verses.kjv: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who conspired against him: Zabad, the son of Shimeath, an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, the son of Shimrith, a Moabite woman.

verses.kjv: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Now about his sons, and the many burdens placed on him, and the repairs of the house of God, look, these things are written in the record of the book of the kings. And Amaziah, his son, became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not with a completely sincere heart.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.decoded: When the kingdom was firmly established for him, he killed the servants who had killed his father, the king.

verses.kjv: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.decoded: But he did not kill their children; instead, he followed what is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, 'Fathers will not die for their children, and children will not die for their fathers; each person will die for their own sin.'

verses.kjv: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.decoded: Also, Amaziah gathered all the people of Judah and appointed leaders over thousands and leaders over hundreds, based on their family groups, throughout all Judah and Benjamin. He counted all the men who were twenty years old and older and found three hundred thousand skilled warriors who were able to go to war and use spear and shield.

verses.kjv: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.decoded: He also hired one hundred thousand strong and brave men from Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

verses.kjv: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the Lord is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
verses.decoded: But a man of God came to him and said, "King, do not take the army of Israel with you, because the LORD is not with Israel, specifically with all the descendants of Ephraim."

verses.kjv: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
verses.decoded: But if you want to go, do it; be strong for the battle. God will cause you to fall before the enemy, because God has the power to help and to defeat.

verses.kjv: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The Lord is able to give thee much more than this.
verses.decoded: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what will we do about the hundred talents that I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give you much more than this.

verses.kjv: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.decoded: Then Amaziah sent away the army that had come to him from Ephraim to return home. Because of this, they became very angry with Judah, and they went back home very angry.

verses.kjv: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.decoded: Amaziah made himself strong, led his people out, went to the Valley of Salt, and killed ten thousand of the people of Seir.

verses.kjv: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.decoded: And the children of Judah took another ten thousand survivors captive, brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they were all smashed to pieces.

verses.kjv: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.decoded: But the soldiers from the army that Amaziah sent away so they would not go with him to battle attacked the cities of Judah, from Samaria all the way to Beth-horon, killed three thousand of the people, and took a lot of loot.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.decoded: After Amaziah returned from killing the Edomites, he took the gods of the people of Seir, set them up as his gods, bowed down to them, and burned incense to them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
verses.decoded: Therefore the anger of the LORD was aroused against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said to him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people, who could not rescue their own people from your hand?

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.decoded: And it happened, as he was talking with him, that the king said to him, "Are you part of the king’s advisors? Stop; why should you be struck?" Then the prophet stopped and said, "I know that God has decided to destroy you because you have done this and have not listened to my advice."

verses.kjv: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.decoded: Then Amaziah, king of Judah, sought advice and sent a message to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us meet face to face."

verses.kjv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.decoded: And Joash, king of Israel, sent a message to Amaziah, king of Judah, saying, The thistle in Lebanon sent a message to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son as his wife; but then a wild animal from Lebanon came by and trampled the thistle.

verses.kjv: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.decoded: You say, Look, you have defeated the Edomites; and your heart is proud and boastful: stay now at home; why should you get involved and bring harm to yourself, so that you and Judah will fall together?

verses.kjv: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
verses.decoded: But Amaziah did not listen, because it was from God that he would hand them over to their enemies, since they had followed the gods of Edom.

verses.kjv: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
verses.decoded: So Joash, the king of Israel, went up; and they faced each other, both he and Amaziah, the king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

verses.kjv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.decoded: Judah was defeated by Israel, and each person ran back to his own home.

verses.kjv: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: And Joash, the king of Israel, captured Amaziah, the king of Judah, who was the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem. Then he broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, a distance of four hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
verses.decoded: He took all the gold and silver, and all the items found in the house of God with Obed-edom, along with the treasures from the king’s house and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
verses.decoded: Amaziah, the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.decoded: Now the rest of the actions of Amaziah, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

verses.kjv: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the Lord they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
verses.decoded: After Amaziah stopped following the LORD, people in Jerusalem plotted against him; he ran away to Lachish, but they sent people to Lachish to kill him there.

verses.kjv: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
verses.decoded: They carried him on horses and buried him with his ancestors in the city of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.decoded: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

verses.kjv: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.decoded: He built Eloth and gave it back to Judah after the king died.

verses.kjv: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father Amaziah did.

verses.kjv: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him to prosper.
verses.decoded: He sought God during the time of Zechariah, who understood God's visions; and as long as he sought the Lord, God caused him to succeed.

verses.kjv: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
verses.decoded: He went out and fought against the Philistines, broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities around Ashdod and among the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.
verses.decoded: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

verses.kjv: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
verses.decoded: The Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah, and his reputation spread as far as the border of Egypt because he became very strong.

verses.kjv: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
verses.decoded: Also, Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the bend of the wall, and strengthened them.

verses.kjv: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
verses.decoded: He also built towers in the desert and dug many wells because he had many cattle both in the lowlands and in the plains. There were also farmers and vineyard workers in the mountains and in Carmel because he loved farming.

verses.kjv: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
verses.decoded: Also, Uzziah had an army of soldiers who went out to war in groups, counted by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the commander, under the supervision of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

verses.kjv: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: The total number of the leaders of the families of the mighty warriors was two thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.decoded: And under their command was an army of three hundred thousand, seven thousand, and five hundred soldiers, who fought with great strength to support the king against the enemy.

verses.kjv: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
verses.decoded: And Uzziah made shields, spears, helmets, chain mail, bows, and slings to throw stones for the entire army.

verses.kjv: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
verses.decoded: He made weapons in Jerusalem, designed by skilled men, to be placed on the towers and walls, to shoot arrows and large stones. His reputation spread widely because he was wonderfully supported until he became strong.

verses.kjv: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the Lord his God, and went into the temple of the Lord to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
verses.decoded: But when he became strong, his pride led to his downfall because he disobeyed the LORD his God and entered the LORD's temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

verses.kjv: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the Lord, that were valiant men:
verses.decoded: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him were eighty priests of the LORD, who were brave men:

verses.kjv: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the Lord, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the Lord God.
verses.decoded: And they opposed King Uzziah and said to him, It does not belong to you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but to the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, because you have trespassed; it will not bring you honor from the LORD God.

verses.kjv: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the Lord, from beside the incense altar.
verses.decoded: Then Uzziah became angry and held a censer in his hand to burn incense. While he was angry with the priests, leprosy appeared on his forehead in front of the priests in the house of the LORD, next to the incense altar.

verses.kjv: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the Lord had smitten him.
verses.decoded: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him and saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they forced him to leave. He also hurried to leave because the LORD had struck him.

verses.kjv: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord: and Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
verses.decoded: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house because he was a leper; he was excluded from the LORD’s temple. His son Jotham was in charge of the king’s palace and governed the people of the land.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
verses.decoded: Now the other events of Uzziah's reign, from beginning to end, were written down by Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

verses.kjv: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Uzziah died, and they buried him with his ancestors in the burial ground that belonged to the kings, because they said, He is a leper; and Jotham his son became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.decoded: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to rule, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the Lord. And the people did yet corruptly.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father Uzziah did; however, he did not enter the LORD's temple. But the people were still doing wrong.

verses.kjv: He built the high gate of the house of the Lord, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
verses.decoded: He constructed the main gate of the house of the LORD, and he built extensively on the wall of Ophel.

verses.kjv: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
verses.decoded: In addition, he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built forts and towers.

verses.kjv: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
verses.decoded: He also fought against the king of the Ammonites and defeated them. The people of Ammon gave him that same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand measures of barley. The people of Ammon paid him this amount in the second year and the third year as well.

verses.kjv: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.
verses.decoded: Jotham became strong because he made his life right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.decoded: Now the rest of the actions of Jotham, all his wars, and his behavior, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jotham died and was buried in the city of David, and his son Ahaz became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord, like David his father:
verses.decoded: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, but he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD, like David his father did.

verses.kjv: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
verses.decoded: Because he followed the practices of the kings of Israel and also made metal idols for Baalim.

verses.kjv: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Also, he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom and burned his children in the fire, following the disgusting practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.decoded: He also offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD his God handed him over to the king of Syria; and they defeated him, capturing a large number of his people and took them to Damascus. He was also handed over to the king of Israel, who defeated him with a great slaughter.

verses.kjv: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.decoded: Because they had abandoned the LORD God of their ancestors, Pekah, the son of Remaliah, killed one hundred and twenty thousand brave men in Judah in a single day.

verses.kjv: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
verses.decoded: And Zichri, a strong man from Ephraim, killed Maaseiah, the king’s son, and Azrikam, the governor of the palace, and Elkanah, who was close to the king.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel captured two hundred thousand of their relatives, including women, sons, and daughters, and also took a large amount of loot from them, bringing the loot to Samaria.

verses.kjv: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the Lord God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
verses.decoded: But a prophet of the LORD was there, named Oded. He went out ahead of the army that came to Samaria and said to them, Look, because the LORD God of your ancestors was angry with Judah, he has handed them over to you, and you have killed them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.

verses.kjv: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the Lord your God?
verses.decoded: And now you plan to make the people of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves and servants: but do you not have sins against the LORD your God right here with you?

verses.kjv: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the Lord is upon you.
verses.decoded: Now listen to me and release the captives you have taken from your own people, because the intense anger of the LORD is against you.

verses.kjv: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
verses.decoded: Then some of the leaders of the descendants of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came back from the battle,

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the Lord already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.
verses.decoded: And said to them, You shall not bring the captives here: because we have already offended the LORD, and you intend to add more to our sins and to our wrongdoing: for our wrongdoing is great, and there is fierce anger against Israel.

verses.kjv: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
verses.decoded: So the soldiers left the captives and the loot in front of the leaders and the entire assembly.

verses.kjv: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
verses.decoded: The men who were specifically named stood up, took the captives, and with the loot clothed everyone who was naked among them, dressed them, put shoes on them, gave them food and drink, anointed them, carried all who were weak on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their relatives. Then they returned to Samaria.

verses.kjv: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.decoded: At that time, King Ahaz sent messengers to the kings of Assyria to ask for their help.

verses.kjv: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
verses.decoded: Because the Edomites came again and attacked Judah, capturing people and taking them away as prisoners.

verses.kjv: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
verses.decoded: The Philistines also invaded the cities in the lowlands and the southern part of Judah, and they captured Beth-shemesh, Ajalon, Gederoth, Shocho along with its villages, Timnah along with its villages, and Gimzo along with its villages; and they lived there.

verses.kjv: For the Lord brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the Lord.
verses.decoded: The LORD humbled Judah because of Ahaz, king of Israel; he exposed Judah to shame and greatly sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
verses.decoded: And Tilgath-pilneser, king of Assyria, came to him and caused him trouble, but did not help him.

verses.kjv: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the Lord, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
verses.decoded: Because Ahaz took a portion from the house of the LORD, from the king's house, and from the officials, and gave it to the king of Assyria, but the king of Assyria did not help him.

verses.kjv: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the Lord: this is that king Ahaz.
verses.decoded: And during his time of trouble, he sinned even more against the LORD: this is King Ahaz.

verses.kjv: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
verses.decoded: He sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, who struck him down; and he said, 'Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, I will sacrifice to them so they may help me.' But those gods caused his destruction and the destruction of all Israel.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the Lord, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Ahaz gathered all the utensils from the house of God, broke them into pieces, closed the doors of the house of the LORD, and built altars for himself in every corner of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the Lord God of his fathers.
verses.decoded: In every city of Judah, he built high places to burn incense to other gods, which angered the LORD God of his ancestors.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.decoded: Now the rest of his actions and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Ahaz died and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but they did not put him in the tombs of the kings of Israel. His son Hezekiah became king after him.

verses.kjv: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father David had done.

verses.kjv: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.
verses.decoded: In the first year of his reign, during the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and fixed them.

verses.kjv: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
verses.decoded: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together on the east street,

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
verses.decoded: And said to them, Listen to me, Levites, make yourselves holy now, and make the house of the LORD God of your ancestors holy, and remove the uncleanness from the holy place.

verses.kjv: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the Lord, and turned their backs.
verses.decoded: Because our ancestors sinned and did what was wrong in the sight of the LORD our God, they abandoned Him, turned their faces away from the LORD's dwelling place, and turned their backs on Him.

verses.kjv: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: They have also closed the doors of the entrance, put out the lamps, and have not burned incense or offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the wrath of the Lord was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
verses.decoded: Therefore the anger of the LORD was against Judah and Jerusalem, and he has brought trouble, confusion, and disgrace upon them, as you see with your own eyes.

verses.kjv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.decoded: For look, our fathers have died by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity because of this.

verses.kjv: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.decoded: Now I want to make a promise with the LORD God of Israel so that his strong anger will turn away from us.

verses.kjv: My sons, be not now negligent: for the Lord hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
verses.decoded: My sons, do not be careless now, because the LORD has chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, to minister to him, and to burn incense.

verses.kjv: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
verses.decoded: Then the Levites stood up: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel, the son of Azariah, from the descendants of the Kohathites; and from the descendants of Merari, Kish, the son of Abdi, and Azariah, the son of Jehalelel; and from the Gershonites, Joah, the son of Zimmah, and Eden, the son of Joah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
verses.decoded: From the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel; and from the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei; and from the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the Lord, to cleanse the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They gathered their fellow Israelites, made themselves holy, and came as the king commanded, following the instructions of the LORD, to purify the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
verses.decoded: The priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to clean it, and they brought out all the impurity they found in the temple of the LORD into the courtyard of the house of the LORD. Then the Levites took it to carry it outside to the Kidron Valley.

verses.kjv: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the Lord: so they sanctified the house of the Lord in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
verses.decoded: They started to make holy the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the entrance of the LORD's temple. They made the LORD's house holy in eight days, and finished on the sixteenth day of the first month.

verses.kjv: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the Lord, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
verses.decoded: Then they went to King Hezekiah and said, We have purified the entire house of the LORD, the altar for burnt offerings, along with all its utensils, and the table for the showbread, with all its utensils.

verses.kjv: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also, all the vessels that King Ahaz threw away during his sin have we prepared and made holy, and look, they are in front of the altar of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then King Hezekiah got up early, gathered the leaders of the city, and went to the house of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the LORD.

verses.kjv: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
verses.decoded: So they killed the bulls, and the priests took the blood and sprinkled it on the altar; in the same way, after they killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood on the altar; they also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

verses.kjv: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
verses.decoded: They brought the male goats for the sin offering in front of the king and the assembly, and they placed their hands on them.

verses.kjv: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
verses.decoded: The priests killed them, and they made peace with their blood on the altar to make atonement for all Israel because the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering be made for all Israel.

verses.kjv: And he set the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the Lord by his prophets.
verses.decoded: He placed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, following the instructions of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet, because this was the LORD’s command through his prophets.

verses.kjv: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.decoded: The Levites stood with the musical instruments of David, and the priests stood with the trumpets.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the Lord began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah gave the order to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering started, the song of the LORD also began, accompanied by trumpets and the instruments that King David of Israel had arranged.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.decoded: And everyone in the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpet players played; all of this went on until the burnt offering was completed.

verses.kjv: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
verses.decoded: And when they had finished offering, the king and everyone who was with him bowed down and worshiped.

verses.kjv: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the Lord with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.decoded: Also, King Hezekiah and the leaders told the Levites to sing praises to the LORD using the words of David and Asaph the prophet. They sang happily, bowed their heads, and worshiped.

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the Lord, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now that you have dedicated yourselves to the LORD, come close and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were willing with a sincere heart offered burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.decoded: The number of burnt offerings that the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All of these were burnt offerings to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
verses.decoded: The dedicated offerings were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.kjv: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
verses.decoded: But there were not enough priests to skin all the burnt offerings, so their fellow Levites helped them until the work was finished and until the other priests had made themselves holy, because the Levites were more sincere in making themselves holy than the priests.

verses.kjv: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the Lord was set in order.
verses.decoded: There were also many burnt offerings, along with the fat from the peace offerings, and drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the worship in the house of the LORD was organized properly.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah was happy, and all the people were happy, because God had prepared the people: the event happened suddenly.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah sent messages to all Israel and Judah, and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, asking them to come to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover to the Lord God of Israel.

verses.kjv: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
verses.decoded: Because the king had planned together with his officials and all the people in Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover in the second month.

verses.kjv: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: They could not celebrate it at that time because the priests had not made themselves holy enough, and the people had not gathered together in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
verses.decoded: The king and all the people were pleased with the matter.

verses.kjv: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the Lord God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
verses.decoded: So they issued an order to announce throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, that they should come to celebrate the Passover to the LORD God of Israel in Jerusalem, because they had not done it for a long time in the way it was written.

verses.kjv: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.decoded: So the messengers went with the letters from the king and his officials throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the king's command, saying, You people of Israel, return to the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will come back to the remaining few of you who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the Lord God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
verses.decoded: Do not be like your fathers and your brothers who sinned against the LORD God of their fathers, so He allowed them to be destroyed, as you see.

verses.kjv: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the Lord, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the Lord your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
verses.decoded: Now do not be stubborn, like your ancestors were, but submit yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has made holy forever; and serve the LORD your God, so that the intensity of his anger may turn away from you.

verses.kjv: For if ye turn again unto the Lord, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the Lord your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
verses.decoded: For if you turn back to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find mercy from those who have taken them captive, so that they will return to this land; because the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and he will not turn his face away from you if you return to him.

verses.kjv: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
verses.decoded: So the messengers went from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh all the way to Zebulun, but they laughed at them and made fun of them.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: However, some people from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also in Judah, God enabled them to be united in heart to obey the command of the king and the officials, following the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
verses.decoded: Many people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the second month, a very large group.

verses.kjv: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
verses.decoded: They got up and removed the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

verses.kjv: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then they slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month; and the priests and the Levites felt ashamed, purified themselves, and brought the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
verses.decoded: They stood in their assigned places according to their custom, following the law given by Moses, the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood, which they received from the Levites.

verses.kjv: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: Because many in the group were not made holy, the Levites were responsible for killing the Passover lambs for everyone who was not clean, to make them holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good Lord pardon every one
verses.decoded: Because many people, including many from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not purified themselves, they still ate the Passover in a way that was not according to the instructions. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, 'May the good LORD forgive everyone.'

verses.kjv: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the Lord God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: Who prepares his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his ancestors, even if he has not been purified according to the cleansing rituals of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the Lord hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.decoded: The LORD listened to Hezekiah and healed the people.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the Lord day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel who were in Jerusalem celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy. The Levites and the priests praised the LORD every day, singing loudly with musical instruments to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the Lord: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who taught the good knowledge of the LORD, and they ate throughout the seven-day feast, offering peace offerings and confessing to the LORD God of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
verses.decoded: The entire group decided to celebrate for another seven days, and they celebrated for another seven days with joy.

verses.kjv: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.decoded: Because Hezekiah, king of Judah, gave the assembly one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the leaders gave the assembly one thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and many priests made themselves holy.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
verses.decoded: All the people of Judah, along with the priests and the Levites, and all the people who came from Israel, including the foreigners who came from the land of Israel and lived in Judah, were joyful.

verses.kjv: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: There was great joy in Jerusalem because since the time of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel, there had not been anything like it in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
verses.decoded: Then the priests, the Levites, stood up and blessed the people; their voices were heard, and their prayer went up to God's holy dwelling place, all the way to heaven.

verses.kjv: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
verses.decoded: When all of this was completed, all the Israelites who were there went to the cities of Judah, broke the idols into pieces, cut down the sacred trees, and tore down the high places and altars throughout all Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they completely destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned, each person to their own property, back to their own cities.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah organized the groups of priests and Levites according to their groups, each person according to their duty, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and peace offerings, to serve, to give thanks, and to praise at the entrances of the LORD’s tents.

verses.kjv: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He also set aside the king’s share of his wealth for the burnt offerings, specifically for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the appointed festivals, as it is written in the law of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also, he instructed the people living in Jerusalem to give the share for the priests and the Levites, so that they could be supported in following the law of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
verses.decoded: As soon as the command was announced, the people of Israel brought in large amounts of the first fruits of grain, wine, oil, honey, and all the crops from the fields; and they also brought in large amounts of the tithe of everything.

verses.kjv: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the Lord their God, and laid them by heaps.
verses.decoded: And regarding the people of Israel and Judah who lived in the cities of Judah, they also brought the tenth part of oxen and sheep, and the tenth part of holy things that were dedicated to the LORD their God, and piled them up in heaps.

verses.kjv: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
verses.decoded: In the third month, they started to build the foundations of the piles, and completed them in the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.
verses.decoded: When Hezekiah and the leaders came and saw the piles, they praised the LORD and his people Israel.

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites about the piles.

verses.kjv: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the Lord, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the Lord hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
verses.decoded: Azariah, the chief priest from the house of Zadok, answered him and said, Since the people started bringing offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and have even had plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed his people; and what remains is this large supply.

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the Lord; and they prepared them,
