verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah gave the order to prepare rooms in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,

verses.kjv: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
verses.decoded: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated items faithfully. Cononiah the Levite was in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was the second in command.

verses.kjv: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
verses.decoded: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were supervisors working under Cononiah and his brother Shimei, following the orders of King Hezekiah and Azariah, the leader of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the Lord, and the most holy things.
verses.decoded: And Kore, the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper on the east side, was in charge of the freewill offerings to God, to distribute the offerings to the LORD and the most holy items.

verses.kjv: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
verses.decoded: Next to him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their assigned duty, to distribute to their fellow priests by their appointed order, both to the important and to the less important.

verses.kjv: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the Lord, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
verses.decoded: In addition to their family records of males from three years old and older, each person who entered the house of the LORD received their daily portion for their service in their assigned duties according to their schedules;

verses.kjv: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
verses.decoded: Both to the family records of the priests according to their ancestral houses, and to the Levites from twenty years old and older, in their assigned duties according to their groups;

verses.kjv: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
verses.decoded: And to the family records of all their children, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, throughout the entire assembly: because in their appointed duties they made themselves holy.

verses.kjv: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
verses.decoded: Also, the sons of Aaron the priests who were living in the fields near the outskirts of their cities, in each city, the men who were named, were assigned to give portions to all the male priests and to all those who were counted by their family records among the Levites.

verses.kjv: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the Lord his God.
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah did this throughout all Judah, and did what was good, right, and true in the sight of the LORD his God.

verses.kjv: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
verses.decoded: In every task he started in serving the house of God, following the law, and obeying the commandments to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and succeeded.

verses.kjv: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
verses.decoded: After these events and their completion, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came and entered Judah. He camped against the walled cities and planned to capture them for himself.

verses.kjv: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had arrived and that he planned to fight against Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
verses.decoded: He consulted with his leaders and his warriors to block the water sources outside the city, and they helped him.

verses.kjv: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
verses.decoded: So many people gathered together and stopped all the springs and the stream that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water?

verses.kjv: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.
verses.decoded: He also made himself stronger, rebuilt all the broken walls, raised them up to the towers, built another wall outside, repaired Millo in the city of David, and made many darts and shields.

verses.kjv: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
verses.decoded: He appointed military commanders over the people, gathered them together in the street by the city gate, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

verses.kjv: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
verses.decoded: Be strong and brave, do not be afraid or discouraged because of the king of Assyria or all the people with him, because there are more with us than with him.

verses.kjv: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
verses.decoded: He has human strength on his side, but we have the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles. The people trusted the words of Hezekiah, king of Judah.

verses.kjv: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,
verses.decoded: After this, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent his officials to Jerusalem (but he himself was attacking Lachish with all his army) to Hezekiah, king of Judah, and to all the people of Judah in Jerusalem, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: This is what Sennacherib, king of Assyria, says: What are you trusting in to stay under siege in Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The Lord our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.decoded: Doesn't Hezekiah convince you to surrender yourselves to die from hunger and thirst, saying, The LORD our God will rescue us from the power of the king of Assyria?

verses.kjv: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
verses.decoded: Has not the same Hezekiah removed his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar, and burn incense on it?

verses.kjv: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
verses.decoded: Do you not know what I and my ancestors have done to all the people of other countries? Were the gods of those nations able in any way to save their lands from my control?

verses.kjv: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
verses.decoded: Was there any god among all the gods of those nations that my ancestors completely destroyed who could rescue his people from my power, so that your God could rescue you from my power?

verses.kjv: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?
verses.decoded: So now, do not let Hezekiah deceive you or convince you in this way, and do not believe him. For no god of any nation or kingdom was able to rescue his people from my hand or from the hand of my ancestors. How much less will your God rescue you from my hand?

verses.kjv: And his servants spake yet more against the Lord God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
verses.decoded: And his servants spoke even more against the LORD God and against His servant Hezekiah.

verses.kjv: He wrote also letters to rail on the Lord God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
verses.decoded: He also wrote letters to insult the LORD God of Israel and to speak against Him, saying, Just as the gods of the nations of other lands have not saved their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not save His people from my hand.

verses.kjv: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
verses.decoded: Then they shouted loudly in the language of the Jews to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to scare them and disturb them so that they could capture the city.

verses.kjv: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
verses.decoded: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as if He were like the gods of the peoples of the earth, which were made by human hands.

verses.kjv: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
verses.decoded: Because of this, King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz, prayed and cried out to heaven.

verses.kjv: And the Lord sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
verses.decoded: The LORD sent an angel who killed all the brave warriors, the leaders, and the commanders in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned to his own land with a shameful face. When he entered the house of his god, those who were born from his own body killed him there with the sword.

verses.kjv: Thus the Lord saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
verses.decoded: So the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people living in Jerusalem from the power of Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, and from the power of everyone else, and He protected them from all directions.

verses.kjv: And many brought gifts unto the Lord to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
verses.decoded: Many people brought gifts to the LORD in Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah, king of Judah; so he was honored by all the nations from that time on.

verses.kjv: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the Lord: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
verses.decoded: At that time Hezekiah was very sick and close to death, and he prayed to the LORD. The LORD spoke to him and gave him a sign.

verses.kjv: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: But Hezekiah did not respond properly to the kindness shown to him, because he became proud; therefore, anger came upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the Lord came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
verses.decoded: However, Hezekiah humbled himself because of the pride in his heart, both he and the people living in Jerusalem, so that the anger of the LORD did not come upon them during the time of Hezekiah.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
verses.decoded: Hezekiah had very great wealth and honor, and he made storage places for silver, gold, precious stones, spices, shields, and all kinds of valuable jewels.

verses.kjv: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
verses.decoded: There were also storehouses for the surplus of grain, wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and pens for flocks.

verses.kjv: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
verses.decoded: In addition, he gave him cities and large amounts of flocks and herds because God had given him great wealth.

verses.kjv: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah also stopped the upper water channel of Gihon and directed it straight down to the west side of the city of David. Hezekiah succeeded in all his efforts.

verses.kjv: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
verses.decoded: However, regarding the ambassadors from the princes of Babylon who sent to him to ask about the miracle that happened in the land, God allowed him to be tested so that He could know everything in his heart.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.decoded: The other events of Hezekiah's reign and his good deeds are recorded in the writings of Isaiah the prophet, son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah died and was buried in the most important tomb of the descendants of David. All of Judah and the people living in Jerusalem honored him when he died. Then his son Manasseh became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: Manasseh was twelve years old when he started to rule, and he ruled for fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: But did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like the disgusting practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.decoded: He rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed, set up altars for Baal, made wooden idols, worshiped all the stars in the sky, and served them.

verses.kjv: Also he built altars in the house of the Lord, whereof the Lord had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
verses.decoded: He also built altars in the house of the LORD, where the LORD had said, 'My name will be there forever in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He built altars for all the heavenly armies in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.decoded: He made his children walk through fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He also practiced astrology, used spells, practiced witchcraft, communicated with spirits, and consulted wizards. He did many evil things in the eyes of the LORD to make Him very angry.

verses.kjv: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
verses.decoded: He placed a carved image, the idol he had made, in the house of God, about which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, 'In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen above all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.'

verses.kjv: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: I will no longer remove Israel from the land I gave to your ancestors, so that they will pay attention to obey everything I commanded them through the entire law, the statutes, and the rules given by Moses.

verses.kjv: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: So Manasseh caused Judah and the people living in Jerusalem to go astray, and to do worse than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they did not listen.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the Lord brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.decoded: Therefore the LORD allowed the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria to come against them, and they captured Manasseh among the thorns, bound him with chains, and took him to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And when he was in affliction, he besought the Lord his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
verses.decoded: And when he was in trouble, he begged the LORD his God for help and humbled himself deeply before the God of his ancestors,

verses.kjv: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord he was God.
verses.decoded: He prayed to him, and he was moved by his prayer, listened to his request, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom. Then Manasseh realized that the LORD is God.

verses.kjv: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
verses.decoded: After this, he built a wall outside the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, reaching to the entrance at the Fish Gate. He surrounded Ophel and raised the wall to a very great height. He also placed military commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.

verses.kjv: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
verses.decoded: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the LORD, along with all the altars he had built on the hill of the house of the LORD and in Jerusalem, and he threw them out of the city.

verses.kjv: And he repaired the altar of the Lord, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: He fixed the altar of the LORD, offered peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and told Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the Lord their God only.
verses.decoded: However, the people continued to offer sacrifices on the high places, but only to the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: Now the other actions of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the messages of the prophets who spoke to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, look, they are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.
verses.decoded: His prayer as well, and how God was moved by him, and all his sin and wrongdoing, and the places where he built high places, and set up groves and carved images, before he was humbled: look, they are written among the sayings of the prophets.

verses.kjv: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Manasseh died, and they buried him in his own house; and his son Amon became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for two years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
verses.decoded: But he did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like Manasseh his father did: because Amon offered sacrifices to all the carved idols that Manasseh his father had made, and he worshiped them;

verses.kjv: And humbled not himself before the Lord, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
verses.decoded: He did not humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; instead, Amon sinned more and more.

verses.kjv: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
verses.decoded: His servants planned against him and killed him in his own house.

verses.kjv: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.decoded: But the people of the land killed everyone who had plotted against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah, his son, king instead of him.

verses.kjv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
verses.decoded: Josiah was eight years old when he started to rule, and he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-one years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, followed the ways of David his father, and did not turn to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
verses.decoded: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he started to seek the God of David his ancestor. In the twelfth year, he began to remove from Judah and Jerusalem the high places, the sacred groves, the carved idols, and the metal images.

verses.kjv: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
verses.decoded: They destroyed the altars of Baal in his presence; and he cut down the images that were above them; and he broke into pieces the sacred groves, the carved images, and the molten images, turning them into dust and scattering it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

verses.kjv: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars and purified Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
verses.decoded: And he did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even up to Naphtali, using their mattocks all around.

verses.kjv: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: After he destroyed the altars and the sacred trees, crushed the carved images into dust, and cut down all the idols throughout the entire land of Israel, he went back to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
verses.decoded: In the eighteenth year of his reign, after he had cleansed the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah, the governor of the city, and Joah, the son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the temple of the LORD his God.

verses.kjv: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites who guarded the doors had collected from the people of Manasseh and Ephraim, and from all the remaining people of Israel, as well as from all Judah and Benjamin; then they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the Lord, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the Lord, to repair and amend the house:
verses.decoded: They gave it to the workers who were in charge of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workers who were working in the house of the LORD to repair and fix the house.

verses.kjv: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
verses.decoded: They also gave it to the craftsmen and builders to buy cut stone and wood for supports and to repair the floors of the houses that the kings of Judah had destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
verses.decoded: The men did the work faithfully, and their supervisors were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites from the family of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, from the family of the Kohathites, to advance the work; and other Levites, all who were skilled in playing musical instruments.

verses.kjv: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
verses.decoded: They were also in charge of the carriers of loads and supervised everyone who did any kind of work. Among the Levites, there were writers, officials, and gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the Lord given by Moses.
verses.decoded: When they took out the money that had been brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD that Moses had given.

verses.kjv: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
verses.decoded: Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. Then Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

verses.kjv: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
verses.decoded: And Shaphan brought the book to the king, and reported back to the king, saying, Everything that was given to your servants, they are doing it.

verses.kjv: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
verses.decoded: They collected the money that was found in the house of the LORD and gave it to the supervisors and the workers.

verses.kjv: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.decoded: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it in front of the king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the king heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
verses.decoded: The king gave orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah, a servant of the king, saying,

verses.kjv: Go, inquire of the Lord for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to do after all that is written in this book.
verses.decoded: Go, ask the LORD for me and for the people remaining in Israel and Judah about the words of the book that has been found, because the LORD's anger against us is very great, since our ancestors did not obey the LORD's commands or follow everything written in this book.

verses.kjv: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
verses.decoded: Hilkiah and the men the king had appointed went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum, son of Tikvath, son of Hasrah, who was the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem in the college. They spoke to her about that matter.

verses.kjv: And she answered them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
verses.decoded: And she answered them, This is what the LORD God of Israel says, Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, Look, I will bring disaster on this place and on its people, even all the curses that are written in the book they read before the king of Judah:

verses.kjv: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.decoded: Because they have abandoned me and have burned incense to other gods to make me angry with all the things they have made, my anger will be poured out on this place and will not be stopped.

verses.kjv: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;
verses.decoded: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to ask the LORD, you shall say to him, This is what the LORD God of Israel says about the words you have heard;

verses.kjv: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and you humbled yourself before me, tore your clothes, and wept before me; I have heard you also, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring you to your ancestors, and you will be laid to rest in peace; your eyes will not see all the disaster I will bring on this place and its people. Then they reported this message to the king again.

verses.kjv: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then the king sent for and gathered all the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The king went into the house of the LORD, along with all the men of Judah, the people living in Jerusalem, the priests, the Levites, and everyone, both important and ordinary; and he read aloud to them all the words from the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
verses.decoded: The king stood in his position and made a promise before the LORD to follow the LORD, to obey his commandments, his testimonies, and his laws with all his heart and all his soul, to carry out the words of the covenant written in this book.

verses.kjv: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
verses.decoded: He made all the people living in Jerusalem and Benjamin agree to it. The people of Jerusalem followed the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the Lord their God. And all his days they departed not from following the Lord, the God of their fathers.
verses.decoded: Josiah removed all the detestable practices from all the lands that belonged to the people of Israel, and he made everyone living in Israel serve the LORD their God. Throughout his entire life, they did not stop following the LORD, the God of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the Lord in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.decoded: Also, Josiah celebrated the Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem, and they sacrificed the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.kjv: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the Lord,
verses.decoded: He assigned the priests to their duties and encouraged them to serve in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the Lord, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the Lord your God, and his people Israel,
verses.decoded: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were dedicated to the LORD, "Place the holy ark in the temple that Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel, built; it will not be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel."

verses.kjv: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
verses.decoded: Get ready at the homes of your ancestors, following your assigned groups, according to the instructions written by David, king of Israel, and according to the instructions written by his son Solomon.

verses.kjv: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
verses.decoded: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the family groups of the ancestors of your fellow people, and according to the divisions of the family groups of the Levites.

verses.kjv: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: So slaughter the Passover lamb, set yourselves apart, and prepare your brothers, so that they may follow the instructions of the LORD given through Moses.

verses.kjv: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king’s substance.
verses.decoded: And Josiah gave to the people from the flock, lambs and young goats, all for the Passover offerings, for everyone who was present, totaling thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls; these came from the king’s own resources.

verses.kjv: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
verses.decoded: And his leaders gave willingly to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred sheep, and three hundred oxen.

verses.kjv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
verses.decoded: Conaniah, Shemaiah, and Nethaneel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, leaders of the Levites, gave to the Levites for Passover offerings five thousand sheep and five hundred oxen.

verses.kjv: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
verses.decoded: The service was prepared, and the priests stood in their assigned places, and the Levites stood in their divisions, following the king’s command.

verses.kjv: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
verses.decoded: They killed the Passover lamb, and the priests sprinkled the blood with their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

verses.kjv: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
verses.decoded: They took away the burnt offerings so they could distribute them according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer to the LORD, just as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the oxen.

verses.kjv: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
verses.decoded: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the law, but they boiled the other holy offerings in pots, caldrons, and pans, and quickly distributed them among all the people.

verses.kjv: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
verses.decoded: After that, they prepared food for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the sons of Aaron, were busy offering burnt offerings and the fat until evening. Therefore, the Levites prepared food for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

verses.kjv: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
verses.decoded: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their assigned places, following the instructions of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers stayed at each gate; they were not allowed to leave their duties, because their fellow Levites prepared everything for them.

verses.kjv: So all the service of the Lord was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
verses.decoded: So all the work for the LORD was ready on the same day, to celebrate the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, following the instructions of King Josiah.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel who were there celebrated the Passover at that time, and they observed the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

verses.kjv: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: There was no Passover celebration like the one held in Israel since the time of the prophet Samuel; none of the kings of Israel had observed such a Passover as Josiah did, along with the priests, the Levites, all the people of Judah and Israel who were there, and the residents of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
verses.decoded: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah's reign, this Passover was celebrated.

verses.kjv: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
verses.decoded: After all these things, when Josiah had made the temple ready, Necho, king of Egypt, went up to fight against Charchemish near the Euphrates River, and Josiah went out to meet him.

verses.kjv: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.
verses.decoded: But he sent messengers to him, saying, What do I have to do with you, king of Judah? I am not coming against you today, but against the house I am at war with; because God commanded me to hurry. Stay away from interfering with God, who is with me, so that He does not destroy you.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.decoded: However, Josiah did not turn away from him, but disguised himself so that he could fight against him, and he did not listen to the words of Necho, which came from God, and went to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

verses.kjv: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
verses.decoded: The archers shot at King Josiah, and the king said to his servants, 'Take me away, because I am badly wounded.'

verses.kjv: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.decoded: His servants took him out of that chariot and put him into the second chariot he had; they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the tombs of his ancestors. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah mourned for Josiah, and all the male and female singers spoke about Josiah in their songs of mourning up to this day. They made these songs an official practice in Israel, and they are recorded in the book of lamentations.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the Lord,
verses.decoded: Now the other deeds of Josiah, and his goodness, as it is written in the law of the LORD,

verses.kjv: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.decoded: And his actions, from beginning to end, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and made him king instead of his father in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he ruled for three months in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.decoded: The king of Egypt removed him from power in Jerusalem and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.

verses.kjv: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
verses.decoded: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, his brother, king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Then Necho took Jehoahaz, his brother, and brought him to Egypt.

verses.kjv: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.decoded: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD his God.

verses.kjv: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came against him and put him in chains to take him to Babylon.

verses.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the Lord to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar also took the vessels from the house of the LORD to Babylon and placed them in his temple in Babylon.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Now the other actions of Jehoiakim, and the evil things he did, and what was discovered about him, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son became king after him.

verses.kjv: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he started to be king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months and ten days. He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When the year was finished, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and took him to Babylon, along with the valuable items from the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah, his brother, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke from the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God, but he was stubborn and refused to turn to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the Lord which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Also, all the leading priests and the people sinned greatly by following all the disgusting practices of the foreign nations; and they defiled the house of the LORD, which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the Lord God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
verses.decoded: The LORD God of their ancestors sent messages to them through his messengers, getting up early and sending them repeatedly because he felt compassion for his people and for his temple.

verses.kjv: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
verses.decoded: But they made fun of God's messengers, rejected his words, and treated his prophets badly, until the LORD's anger came against his people, and there was no way to help them.

verses.kjv: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.
verses.decoded: Therefore, he sent the king of the Chaldeans against them, who killed their young men with the sword in the temple, and showed no mercy to young men or young women, old men, or those bent over with age; he handed them all over to him.

verses.kjv: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
verses.decoded: He took all the items from the house of God, both large and small, and the treasures from the house of the LORD, as well as the treasures of the king and his officials; he brought all of these to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
verses.decoded: They burned the house of God, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all its valuable vessels.

verses.kjv: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
verses.decoded: He took those who had escaped by the sword to Babylon, where they served him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia began to rule.

verses.kjv: To fulfil the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
verses.decoded: To fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, until the land had observed its sabbath years; because it remained desolate, it observed sabbath rest for seventy years.

verses.kjv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.decoded: In the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah would be fulfilled, the LORD moved the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, to make a proclamation throughout his entire kingdom and to put it in writing, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the Lord God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The Lord his God be with him, and let him go up.
verses.decoded: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: The LORD God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has commanded me to build a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who among you is there from all his people? May the LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.
